- Walk the target VPC/on-prem networking layout and firewall/egress constraints
- Validate connectivity patterns and required endpoints (IPs/ports)
- Review authentication/identity flow (SAML/OIDC/KMS) and audit logs
- Identify procurement milestones (PO / MSA / SOC2 evidence) and next steps

- Tue Aug 4, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Aug 5, 14:00–15:30

I've attached a short pre-read (pre-read-acme-vpc.pdf) that highlights endpoints and our typical deployment options (hosted vs private VPC). Can you confirm which of those times work and who will attend from your side? Also please let me know if procurement wants to review an MSA draft before the meeting.

Thanks —

- 0–10 min: quick context and success criteria (Vanessa / Alex)
- 10–35 min: network topology and required egress (Acme network lead + Chloe)
- 35–65 min: auth/IAM flows, token/rotation, KMS options (Dev + Rishi)
- 65–85 min: deployment modes (hosted vs private) and perf/latency tradeoffs (Chloe)
- 85–90 min: next steps / action items / procurement asks (Vanessa / procurement)

Please share any current network diagrams (VPC CIDRs, NAT/egress appliances, proxy/firewall rules). Attaching our brief "redwood-vpc-reqs.pdf" — this has the specific endpoints, TCP ports, and recommended firewall rules.

Also note: for private deployments we need a short connectivity test window with your network team (15–30 min) to validate routes; we recommend scheduling that within 3 business days of pilot kickoff.
